# Which dependency versions should be locked for the minimal reproduction in Humanoid-Gym?

> **Current answer:** Use Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.13.1, CUDA 11.7, NumPy 1.23, and Isaac Gym Preview 4 according to the common configuration in this post and the official repository. Run the Isaac Gym examples first, then install in an editable mode for humanoid-gym. Do not attribute errors to outdated NumPy/PyTorch after installation.
